about.title: How it works
about.body: Say "{{phrase}}", then a short command, even with your phone locked or Clovie in the background. For example: "client has arrived" checks in the client who is due now. Anything else opens Clovie with what you said.

privacy.title: Your privacy
privacy.body: The microphone listens on this phone for the wake word only. Nothing is recorded or sent until you speak after "{{phrase}}". Only that short command is recorded and turned into text (see how it is processed when you turn Hey Clovie on). A notification shows while Hey Clovie is on, with a Stop button. Turn it off here any time.

disclosure.what: While Hey Clovie is on, Clovie uses your microphone to listen on this phone for "Hey Clovie". It keeps listening when Clovie is closed or the screen is off, until you turn it off or your chosen times end. Android shows a microphone indicator and a notification the whole time.
disclosure.recording: Nothing is recorded or sent while it waits for the wake phrase. After you say it, Clovie records only the short command you speak.

where.cloud: That short recording is sent over an encrypted connection to Clovie's server, which passes it to our speech-to-text provider (Nerova, running on Microsoft Azure) to turn it into text. It is deleted as soon as it is transcribed and is not stored. The text is used to carry out your request.
where.device: Your phone's own speech recogniser (usually Google's) turns that command into text. Depending on your phone's settings that can involve Google's servers. Clovie does not store the recording.

background.hint: Some phones stop apps that run all day. If Hey Clovie stops listening, allow Clovie to run in the background.
background.samsung: On Samsung: Settings > Battery > Background usage limits > Never sleeping apps > add Clovie.

publicDelete.intro: You can delete your Clovie account and its data at any time.
publicDelete.inAppSteps: Open Clovie, go to Settings, then Account, then Delete account. If you are the only owner of a business you also delete that business, and you confirm by typing its name.
publicDelete.byEmailBody: Cannot open the app? Email support@nerovasystems.com from the address on your account, and we will delete it for you within 30 days.
publicDelete.whatDeletedBody: Your login, email, name, phone and photo, and your push and voice device tokens. If you were the only owner, the business and its bookings, clients and settings are deleted too. A short audit record (that the deletion happened, with no contact details) is kept. Bookings in a business that continues stay in its history without your name.
